analysis.reasonEn: Attempting a rebound after a -4.7% decline over the last 5 trading days. RSI remains at 57.8 in neutral territory, while MACD histogram worsened to -0.8481, maintaining a death cross. Volume ratio of 1.63 (1.63x the 5-day average) shows increased momentum on the rebound attempt. Weekly RSI at 67.0 enters bullish territory. ADX at 18.5 indicates a non-trending phase. Resistance is observed near the 52-week high of $354.47 and the swing resistance at $351.73. The current price of $349.51 is 1.4% below the 52-week high and 0.7% below the swing resistance. A buy entry requires confirmation above the swing resistance, and a sell entry requires confirmation below the swing support at $338.70. Currently in a wait-and-see mode.
